question: Which of the following calipers are used for marking lines, parallel to inside and outside edges and for locating the centre of round bars?
solution:
The correct answer is __Leg and point calipers**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Leg and point calipers__ are used for marking lines parallel to inside and outside edges.
 
• They are also used for locating the centre of round bars.
 
• These calipers have one straight leg and one pointed leg for precise marking.
 
• The design ensures accurate measurement and scribing of lines.
 
• They are a common tool in metalworking, woodworking, and mechanical engineering.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Firm Joint Calipers:**

 
 
• Used for measuring external and internal dimensions of objects.
 
• They have a fixed joint that maintains the set position.
 
 
 
• **Simple Calipers:**
 
 
• Typically used for rough measurements.
 
• They lack precision mechanisms found in advanced calipers.
 
 
 
• **Spring Joint Calipers:**
 
 
• They use a spring for fine adjustments and precise measurements.
 
• Commonly used in machining and engineering tasks.
